name: Minineo Publisher
author: sanjaynegi26

sections.description:
Minineo is an all-in-one AI content, SEO, and publishing platform. It helps you rank on Google and get cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Google’s AI Overviews — without switching between a dozen tools.

Minineo Publisher is the official WordPress plugin that connects your site to the Minineo platform. Once connected, you can publish AI-generated blog posts, SEO pages, and landing pages from Minineo directly to your WordPress site — without ever leaving the Minineo dashboard.

What Minineo Does

  • Blog Article Generator — Generate high-ranking SEO blog posts in seconds using advanced AI and publish them directly to WordPress.
  • AI Page Builder — Create beautiful landing pages and SEO sub-pages automatically and publish to WordPress in one click.
  • Website Audit — Scan your site for SEO issues, content gaps, AI visibility gaps, and discover what to publish next.
  • GEO Score — See how visible your site is to AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Google’s AI Overviews alongside your traditional SEO score.
  • Social Content Generator — Transform your ideas into LinkedIn and X posts, scheduled and published from one dashboard.
  • Analytics — Track performance with Google Analytics and Google Search Console integration.

What This Plugin Does

The plugin creates a secure, token-based connection between your WordPress site and your Minineo account. It replaces the need to share your WordPress admin username or password with any third-party service.

  • Connects your WordPress site to Minineo using a one-time pairing code
  • Publishes blog posts and pages sent from Minineo into WordPress
  • Sideloads remote images into your WordPress media library during publishing
  • Sets the first published image as the featured image automatically
  • Fetches available page templates so Minineo can match your site’s layout
  • Lets you disconnect and rotate access cleanly at any time

Who Is This For?

  • Solo founders and indie marketers who want to create and publish SEO content without hiring a team
  • Growth and performance teams who need a scalable content pipeline connected directly to WordPress
  • Agencies and marketing consultants managing multiple WordPress sites and content workflows

How the Connection Works

No passwords are shared. The plugin generates a short-lived pairing code that is exchanged with Minineo to create a site-specific API token. That token is stored securely in WordPress and used only to receive and publish content from your Minineo account.

Learn more at https://minineo.com

External services

This plugin connects to the Minineo service at https://app.minineo.com.

Data is only sent to Minineo after a site owner explicitly clicks Connect to Minineo or when Minineo publishes content to the site.

During connection, the plugin sends:

  • Site ID
  • Site name
  • Site URL
  • One-time pairing code exchange details

During publishing from Minineo, the plugin receives and processes:

  • Post or page title
  • Slug
  • Excerpt
  • Content HTML
  • Page template slug when applicable

Minineo service links:

  • Website: https://minineo.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://minineo.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://minineo.com/terms-of-service/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the minineo-publisher folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Minineo Publisher in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Click Connect to Minineo.
  5. Complete the secure pairing flow in your Minineo dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Minineo account to use this plugin?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress site to Minineo. You will need a Minineo account to publish content through it. A free plan is available.

Does this plugin send my WordPress admin password to Minineo?

No. The connection uses a short-lived pairing code and stores only a separate site-specific token. Your WordPress credentials are never shared.

What types of content can Minineo publish to WordPress?

Minineo can publish blog posts and pages, including featured images and page templates. Content is generated by Minineo’s AI tools and sent to your site through this plugin.

Can I disconnect the site later?

Yes. Disconnecting removes the Minineo token from WordPress and immediately revokes publishing access.

What happens to images during publishing?

Remote images in content published through Minineo are sideloaded into your WordPress media library. The first image is automatically set as the featured image.

Is this plugin free?

The plugin itself is free. Minineo offers a free plan that includes a limited number of AI-generated articles, landing pages, and social posts each month. Paid plans are available for higher volume.
